notes.title: 【Announcement】TGS 2025 & Next Fest Commemorative Update!!
notes.content: [p]To celebrate [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b] and the [b]October Steam Next Fest[/b], the demo of [i]RETRYS[/i] is getting a [b]major update[/b]![/p][p]We’ve added and improved many elements, including character expressions, a new chase mode, new facilities, and fresh events.[/p][p]I’ve been updating non-stop this past month—totally exhausted 😁[/p][p]Here are the full details of the update!![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🆕 New Features & Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Chase Mode[/b]: when discovered by enemies, thrilling pursuits begin![/p][/*][*][p]Expanded situations where bug programs can be used (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Added reactions when choosing the wrong bug program (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Major renovation of the Cat Mansion (a lot of effort went in!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added brand-new gameplay to the Castle Tower (really made me think!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secret room under the tavern (what happens if you sleep in the bed…?).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jar specialty shop in town (hehe).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the mansion of a wealthy noble, with a mysterious new character.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the route of the first farmer puzzle to include a light detour.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 Visual Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Added eyes and mouths to character sprites (looks nice!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added bug creature character art (what do you think?).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the effect colors when defeating bugs (a bit more horror).[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the cat search event in the Cat Mansion (with retro ’Showa’ references).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Game Over screen.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📖 Story & World-Building[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted event dialogue to better fit story and world (still improving!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added an episode with a boy and his grandmother in town (slightly tear-jerking).[/p][/*][*][p]Added dancers to the tavern (twirl, twirl!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added hints in the inn (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Added hints in the Lost Forest (based on feedback).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 UI & Presentation Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]glitch noise effects[/b] to maps with bug creatures (easier to notice).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted message window size for better readability (a subtle but nice change).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed map effect draw order to appear behind pictures (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved review flow: now you can open the store page directly in your browser (please leave us a review—yoroshiku!).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues occurring in the Cat Mansion.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected missing images on the CRT monitor.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary white edges from character images.[/p][/*][/list]
